# Ashlack Engineering - drawing register

Small fabrication jobs are worked from the drawings kept in this folder. `register/parts-register.txt` lists the drawings the shop needs for the current batch.

# Base frame

Cut from 60 x 60 box section and drilled for the mounting feet.

Bore sizes are taken from the assembly drawing.
